---
title: Examples
description: Complete programs, run top to bottom.
---

An example is a complete program that runs top to bottom, from imports to a
result. For the concepts behind each subsystem, see the
[Guides](../docs/guides.qmd).

## Notebooks

Rendered with stored outputs. Source in `examples/` in the repository.

| Notebook | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [Basics](basics.ipynb) | Primitives, transforms, booleans and materials; a rendered scene, rotated and twisted. |
| [Sketch construction](sketch_construction.ipynb) | Sketch a profile, constrain and solve it, extrude and revolve it, render with the sketch overlay, optimize through the solid. |
| [Constraints](constraints.ipynb) | Degrees of freedom, under-constrained errors, solving a trilateration scene, rendering the result. |
| [Optimization](optimization.ipynb) | Gradients of a volume loss with respect to sphere positions, with explicit arguments and with `extract_parameters` and `functionalize`. |
| [Constrained optimization](constrained_optimization.ipynb) | Minimize ‖p − target‖² subject to \|p\| = 2 with five methods: fixed and relinearized null-space projection, manifold projection, Riemannian gradient descent, penalty. |
| [Rendering](rendering.ipynb) | Forward raymarcher, quality presets, compile-once rendering, early termination, the WebGPU viewer and its WGSL. |

## Scripts

Run from the repository root with `python examples/<name>.py`.

| Script | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [`fem_bracket_optimization.py`](https://github.com/andrinr/cadjoint/blob/main/examples/fem_bracket_optimization.py) | Shape optimization of an L-bracket: CAD parameters → SDF → hex mesh → linear elastic solve (jax-fem or CalculiX) → compliance and mass, minimized with Adam. Writes a convergence CSV and plot and VTK files to `examples/output/`. Requires the `fem` extra and `optax`. |
| [`rendering_gallery.py`](https://github.com/andrinr/cadjoint/blob/main/examples/rendering_gallery.py) | Renders the comparison images in the [Rendering](../docs/rendering.qmd) guide (lighting modes and quality presets) to `docs/assets/`. |
